title: Transfer - Azure Route Server NVA Transit Containment
goal: Inspect Azure Route Server advertisements exchanged with paired NVAs and spokes, determine whether NVA preference rules create oscillation, identify leaked provider-learned prefixes, and classify which mitigations actually resolve each issue.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the skill into Azure Route Server service-insertion, but success still depends entirely on managed-BGP reasoning: detect cycles, enforce valley-free exports, and reject fixes that try to disable provider-controlled connectivity.
